parts.name: Hand (Hour Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of lightweight aluminum for precision and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hour on the clock face by rotating slowly around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central pivot in a continuous, slow motion driven by the clock mechanism.

parts.name: Hand (Minute Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of aluminum and longer than the hour hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes on the clock face, rotating once every hour.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis at a faster rate than the hour hand, driven by the clock’s internal motor.

parts.name: Surface (Clock Face)
parts.Basic_description: This is the clock face, typically made of plastic with printed or embossed numbers.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a readable background for the hands and displays the time markings.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as a reference surface for the rotating hands.

parts.name: Glass (Cover)
parts.Basic_description: This is the transparent glass cover that protects the clock face and hands.
parts.Functional_description: It shields the internal components from dust and damage while allowing visibility.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame (Outer Casing)
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame of the clock, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all internal components together and provides structural support.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the main body of the clock.

parts.name: Hand (Second Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the second hand of the clock, made of lightweight aluminum for smooth motion.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the seconds, rotating once every 60 seconds.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates continuously or in discrete steps depending on the clock mechanism.
